title: Airy Aerated Ethiopian Lamb Ye Beg Alichia
description: A fatty and aerated Ethiopian dish featuring lamb and hard taco shells, made with long-fermentation-dough and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients, kid-friendly and delicious. This unique dish is a twist on traditional Ethiopian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the lamb shoulder, onion, garlic, ginger, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper.
Knead the long-fermentation-dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin circle and place a spoonful of the lamb mixture in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Place the filled dough into the hard taco shells and brush the tops with vegetable oil.
Bake the filled taco shells in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the dough is golden brown.
Remove the taco shells from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the Airy Aerated Ethiopian Lamb Ye Beg Alichia hot and enjoy.
